import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

conn.request("GET", "/rest/v1.0/contract_payments?project_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&contract_id=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE&per_page=SOME_INTEGER_VALUE")

data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))

Python3
x-code-samples.content:
import http.client

conn = http.client.HTTPSConnection("api.procore.com")

payload = "{\"project_id\":66005,\"contract_id\":85302,\"attachments\":[\"string\"],\"contract_payment\":{\"date\":\"2015-09-29\",\"invoice_number\":\"Invoice 123\",\"check_number\":\"ABC93759372\",\"invoice_date\":\"2015-09-20\",\"draw_request_number\":5,\"notes\":\"January Payment\",\"payment_number\":5,\"payment_method\":\"credit_card\",\"amount\":\"1000000.0\",\"origin_id\":\"abc-123\",\"origin_data\":\"XYZ-0012\",\"requisition_id\":123,\"prostore_file_ids\":[1,2,3,4]}}"

headers = { 'content-type': "application/json" }

conn.request("POST", "/rest/v1.0/contract_payments", payload, headers)

res = conn.getresponse()
data = res.read()

print(data.decode("utf-8"))
